biggest_catch: PaidEmail is a pennies-per-day activity and the catalog's '$0.01-$0.05 per email, up to three emails a day' no longer matches official terms for current users — since 2018, reading emails awards variable Scratch & Win progress, not fixed cash per email.
catches: Tiny earnings: even pre-2018 users earned only cents per email; current users get variable Scratch & Win progress instead of fixed cash per email.
Payout threshold: InboxDollars cashout starts at $15 — PaidEmail alone takes months to move the needle.
Privacy/data collection: you opt into sponsored marketing email, and the program is funded by advertisers buying your attention.
Variable availability: email volume is not guaranteed — up to three a day is not a promise, and frequency depends on your profile and advertiser demand.
The catalog's '$0.01-$0.05 per email' rate applies only to members who joined before 2018; current users do not earn cash per email.

steps: Create a free InboxDollars account at inboxdollars.com.
Opt into PaidEmails and confirm the confirmation email InboxDollars sends you.
Read the sponsored PaidEmails that arrive (volume varies; a few per day at most, not guaranteed).
For members since 2018, each read email awards variable Scratch & Win progress rather than fixed cash — play the Scratch & Win card for your chance at a reward.
Keep your email confirmations current; the help center explains how to make sure you keep receiving PaidEmails.
Combine with other InboxDollars activities; cash out once your account reaches the $15 threshold.
timing: Credit/progress accrues on reading each PaidEmail; email volume varies and is not guaranteed.
